what: Simulate Trees with Separately Controlled Imbalance and Branching Times
title: Simulate Trees with Separately Controlled Imbalance and Branching Times
text: Simulate rooted, binary, ultrametric trees topological imbalance distribution branching times set separate parameters. Topology: Aldous’ (1996) beta-splitting model. beta = 0 gives Yule trees, lower values give imbalanced trees higher values balanced ones. Branching times: pure-birth process k lineages splits rate k^c. c = 0 Yule, c < 0 slows diversification towards present (negative gamma; Pybus & Harvey, 2000) c > 0 speeds . gamma statistic depends internode intervals Colless index topology, beta mainly moves Colless index c mainly moves gamma. Documentation: https://diogoprov.github.io/treeshapesim/
